commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Alejandro Quintero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+6' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+5' The resulting corner from Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valencia.
90+5' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
90+4' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
90+3' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+2' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.

90+1' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) will take the corner.
90' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass. It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
89' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends a long ball in, but Augusto Batalla comfortably gathers the ball.
89' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
86' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
83' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
80' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Quintero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
77' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
73' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
73' Problems for Inigo Perez as Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Andrei Ratiu replaces him.
68' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
67' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is being substituted because of an injury. Inigo Perez sends Unai Lopez on the pitch.
65' A lofted cross from Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
63' Jose Gaya (Valencia) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Jesus Vazquez comes onto the pitch to replace him.
61' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Pepelu and he is replaced by Filip Ugrinic (Valencia).
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hugo Duro will be replaced by Umar Sadiq (Valencia).

59' Rayo Vallecano control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
52' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
49' A thunderous effort from long range by Javi Guerra (Valencia) goes well wide of the left post.
48' Unai Nunez (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Quintero no option but to blow his whistle.

46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Stole Dimitrievski easily deals with the threat.
45+1' The foul by Diego Lopez (Valencia) was seen by Alejandro Quintero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Javi Guerra (Valencia) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
44' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Valencia.
43' Javi Guerra (Valencia) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Augusto Batalla.
42' Jose Gaya (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

40' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Javi Guerra, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Diego Lopez (Valencia), who beats Augusto Batalla with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.

37' Luis Rioja (Valencia) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Luis Rioja (Valencia) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.
36' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
35' Eray Comert (Valencia) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
32' Carlos Corberan is forced to make a change. Renzo Saravia (Valencia) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Unai Nunez.
31' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) dribbles into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
29' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Quintero saw the whole situation.
26' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 0:1.
20' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
20' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
19' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
18' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle and it's Hugo Duro (Valencia) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
15' Javi Guerra (Valencia) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
12' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
9' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
8' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
7' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is going to take the penalty!

6' Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Renzo Saravia (Valencia). A penalty is given to Rayo Vallecano!

3' Javi Guerra (Valencia) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
